tool_schemas.name: search_medrxiv_key_words
tool_schemas.description: Executes a medRxiv keyword search for the provided `key_words`, persists the request/parameters, and returns up to `num_results` ranked preprints with basic normalized metadata (including DOI) pulled from cache when available. This endpoint returns only the first N results (no pagination/cursor support). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `key_words` is empty or `num_results` is not a positive integer, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to search, and RATE_LIMITED if operational request limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: search_medrxiv_advanced
tool_schemas.description: Executes an advanced medRxiv search using any provided fields (e.g., term/title/authors/section/date range), persists the request/parameters, and returns up to `num_results` ranked preprints with normalized metadata (including DOI), reusing cached results when possible. This endpoint returns only the first N results (no pagination/cursor support). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if no search fields are provided, dates are invalid (including start_date after end_date), or `num_results` is not a positive integer; UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to search; and RATE_LIMITED if operational request limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: get_medrxiv_metadata
tool_schemas.description: Fetches normalized preprint metadata for the given `doi`, returning a cached record when present and otherwise retrieving it upstream and caching it for reuse. The response is a single metadata object (not paged). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `doi` is missing or malformed, NOT_FOUND if the DOI does not resolve to a medRxiv preprint, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not permitted to access metadata, and RATE_LIMITED if operational request limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: get_current_api_client
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling API client identity resolved from the presented API key, including status, granted scopes, and current daily quota/usage. Refuses UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid, and FORBIDDEN if the client is suspended or deleted.

api_key.description: Caller API key presented for authentication.

tool_schemas.name: list_search_requests
tool_schemas.description: Lists persisted search requests for the calling client in reverse-chronological order, with optional status/tool filtering and page-based pagination. Refuses UNAUTHORIZED for invalid credentials and FORBIDDEN for suspended/deleted clients.

api_key.description: Caller API key presented for authentication.

status.description: Filter by search request lifecycle status.

normalized_query_hash.description: Filter by normalized query hash (exact match).

tool_schemas.name: get_search_request
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single persisted search request by id, including its stored parameters and execution status. Refuses NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist (or is not owned by the caller), UNAUTHORIZED for invalid credentials, and FORBIDDEN for suspended/deleted clients.

api_key.description: Caller API key presented for authentication.

search_request_id.description: Primary key of the search_requests row.

include_results.description: When true, also returns the associated ranked search_results (and basic preprint metadata) for this request.

tool_schemas.name: list_preprints
tool_schemas.description: Lists cached normalized preprints, optionally filtered by DOI/server/category/status and searchable by title text. Returns only non-tombstoned records by default. Refuses UNAUTHORIZED for invalid credentials and FORBIDDEN for suspended/deleted clients.

api_key.description: Caller API key presented for authentication.

server.description: Filter by source server when present on the record.

status.description: Filter by preprint lifecycle status (defaults to active).

tool_schemas.name: get_preprint_by_doi
tool_schemas.description: Returns a single cached preprint record by DOI when present. Refuses NOT_FOUND if the DOI is unknown (or tombstoned unless explicitly requested), UNAUTHORIZED for invalid credentials, and FORBIDDEN for suspended/deleted clients.

api_key.description: Caller API key presented for authentication.

doi.description: DOI of the preprint to fetch.

include_tombstoned.description: When true, allows returning tombstoned records; otherwise tombstoned records behave as NOT_FOUND.

tool_schemas.name: update_preprint_status
tool_schemas.description: Transitions a cached preprint between lifecycle states (active ↔ tombstoned). This is a logical state change only; historical search requests/results remain intact. Refuses VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid transitions, NOT_FOUND if the DOI is unknown, UNAUTHORIZED for invalid credentials, and FORBIDDEN for suspended/deleted clients.

api_key.description: Caller API key presented for authentication.

doi.description: DOI of the preprint to update.

status.description: Target lifecycle status for the preprint.
